// ===== packages/cli/src/files.ts

import type { CampaignSource } from "@dndgen/core";
/** Reads a campaign directory: markdown as text, everything else by path only. */
export declare function loadCampaign(dir: string): Promise<CampaignSource>;

// ===== packages/cli/src/main.ts

#!/usr/bin/env node
export declare function main(argv: string[]): Promise<number>;

// ===== packages/cli/src/remote.ts

export interface RemoteRender {
    /** The Adventure Markdown to render. */
    markdown: string;
    /** Directory the image paths are relative to. */
    root: string;
    /** Image paths to upload with it. */
    assets: string[];
    /** Base URL of a dndgen Worker. */
    endpoint: string;
    token: string | undefined;
    /** Where to write the PDF. */
    output: string;
    log: (line: string) => void;
    /** Milliseconds between status checks. */
    pollInterval?: number;
    /** The fetch to talk to the Worker with; tests pass their own. */
    fetch?: typeof fetch;
}
/** Uploads an adventure to a dndgen Worker, waits for the render and saves the PDF. */
export declare function renderRemote(job: RemoteRender): Promise<void>;
